answer: A Phone SIM bound by signed confirmation letter with annual re-verification ties the identity to something the applicant actually controls: the phone sim answers a fresh challenge, the signed confirmation letter is recorded, and annual re-verification keeps one channel from spawning many identities, so a Sybil farm would need a separate real channel for every fake account. A falcon that appears twice is the tell: the same channel cannot back two identities. The anchor hides nothing and the vertex reveals everything: the binding trail is open to all.
